findings.evidence: Direct D1 accepted NBSP and fullwidth alias values when alias equals normalized_alias, although application normalization applies NFKC and whitespace normalization
findings.violatedInvariant: DB direct writers must not persist non-normalized canonical alias identity
findings.impact: Malformed alias data can persist and differs from application lookup form; wrong Role selection is still prevented
findings.requiredRepair: Enforce a bounded cross-engine alias normalization/character contract or generated canonical representation and add direct PostgreSQL/D1 tests
findings.verification: Same Unicode corpus rejected or deterministically canonicalized by PostgreSQL and D1

findings.path: occupational_role_aliases unique index and alias writer
findings.evidence: Two Role IDs can store the same normalized_alias; resolver returns AMBIGUOUS
findings.violatedInvariant: Duplicate normalized alias state must be rejected or made unambiguous by canonical constraints
findings.impact: No wrong Role selection, but persistent canonical alias ambiguity remains
findings.requiredRepair: Global normalized-alias uniqueness or explicit governed namespace that makes lookup unambiguous, while retaining fail-closed resolution
findings.verification: Direct PostgreSQL/D1 two-Role duplicate alias test rejects or resolves via explicit namespace
